SECRET
1. (S) {TaskForceName} is to transit the Kuril Islands for follow-on convoy raiding operations.
2. (S) SIGINT suggests 2+ enemy SSK intend to obstruct your transit.
3. (S) Initial strikes ineffective against Hachinohe Air Base. Expect unescorted enemy MPA from South West.
4a. (S) Multiple enemy merchant vessels still in traffic lanes. All American and Japanese flagged merchants are considered hostile. Destroy if opportunity presents.
4b. (S) National technical means suggest high-speed USN convoy transiting westbound merchant lanes. Convoy expected to carry critical resupply of RGM-109B TASM and RIM-66D for US 7th Fleet.
5. (S) NOTE 1: Note: due to tight operational schedule, no repair or rearmament facilities are expected post mission. Expend ordnance wisely. Good luck, Comrade.
6. (S) NOTE 2: Neutral traffic present in shipping lanes. Do not sink neutral merchant traffic; NATO remains neutral in this conflict and Moscow cannot afford a 2nd front at this time. Recommend against firing SS-N-12 SANDBOX into dense merchant traffic; missile complex will distribute salvo against all contacts within 20nm of initial point.
SIGNED: Khvatov
KTOF
SECRET
DECL OADR BT
